The '''Flounder''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Spring]] and [[Summer]].  It can also be caught during any season on [[Ginger Island]] West (ocean), South, Southeast, and in the Pirate Cove. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|100}} or in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring or Summer.

Flounder can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Fish Pond==
Flounder can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. The primary output is dark brown Flounder [[Roe]]. However, [[Sea Jelly]] is also possible starting at population 7.

==Tailoring==
Flounder can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Sailor Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Flounder may be randomly requested in [[Spring]] or [[Summer]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|300}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Flounder to be caught in Spring at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.5|Special Order quest added. Can now be caught on [[Ginger Island]] during any season on Island West (ocean), South, Southeast, and in the [[Ginger Island#Pirate Cove|Pirate Cove]].}}
{{History|1.6|Completely revamped the Flounder Fish Pond mechanics by changing Fish Pond quests, reducing spawn time from 3 days to 2 days, and adding [[Sea Jelly]] to possible outputs.}}
